notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.content:
Changed the sprites & names of one of the hidden hero.

Updated 2 hidden achievements related to this hero

Changed the unlock condition for one of this achievement 

Added key bindings to be able to zoom in/out using page up/down keys.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
Added a small Quality of life feature on the UI.

Hovering on the Deck & discard piles with your cursor will now display the content of each pile.
This feature is here to clarify how the deck / draw & discard system works.
As well as help you mitigate the RNG by knowing what you will probably draw in your next chest.

No more wondering if it's really worth it to go for a golden chest. If there's only monsters left in the draw pile, you will be able to know.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
A small patch to fix 2 bugs

BugFixes

 Fixed a bug that would soflock the player in the shop when entering with only 1 health as the shapshifter (shifting as a wizard)
 Fixed a bug that would load the game in an unsuported language when starting the game for the first time

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
The second patch is here !
Some very tough bugs have been fixed + some little updates.

Important : You can no longer drag the camera with left click. Please use Right or Middle Click to drag the camera.

BugFixes

 Fixed a bug that would let the player bomb the last boss without creating a path to his room while equipped with the slingshot.
 Fixed a bug that would prevent the player from bombing the minions in front of the last boss.
 Fixed a bug that would freeze the game loop & lock the hero movements when picking up the holy bomb relic.
 Fixed a bug that would let a hero skip a room by going through a corner when changing direction at a specific time.
 Slightly Increase collider size for rogue heroes. This should prevent a bug that would softlock a level if the  rogue hero tries to fight a boss previously moved to a lure room. (NB: I'm not 100% sure this one is fixed as it is very hard to reproduce and doesn't happen every time. so feel free to report it again if you encounter this bug)


Small updates

 Removed the possibility to drag the camera with the left click as it led too often to players misclicking on rooms & moving their hero by accident. Please use Right or Middle Click to drag the camera.
 Updated the splash screen to let players start the game by clicking.
 Changed the action text on the splash screen to be more generic and not input-specific.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
The first patch is out !

BugFixes

 Fixed a bug that caused new heroes to unlock without unlocking the related achievement if both the hero and the boss die at the same time.
 Added a check to unlock missed achievement caused by the previous bug.
 Fixed a bug that caused to trigger the "you're stuck" screen while using your last bomb when no connections are available on the levels for the tiles in your hand.
 Fixed a bug that created a misscount on the number of rooms placed in level with mini bosses and prevented unlocking a specific achievement.
 Fixed a pathfinding issue that computed unnecessary paths while hovering on the hero current room and would create weird paths on levels with rooms placed as a loop.


QoL feature

 Added the possibility to drag the camera with the mouse middle click.
